paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Teima, end of chapter 5 of Avot: R. Yehudah ben Teima says, “Be bold as a leopard.” Nachalat Avot writes that R. Yehudah ben Teima is called ben Dama; see end of chapter 1 of Eruvin, 17a, near the end. One of the ten martyrs; some say he was not one of the ten, but R. Elazar ben Dama was. See there, and part 1, year 3880. The law follows him in Bava Metzia 94 and Gittin 84. Pesachim 112 repeats his maxim under the heading Tanna DeVei Eliyahu. R. Yochanan ben Dehavai, in his name. “Support and staff” concerning R. Yehudah ben Teima: Chagigah 14a. His burial is at Kefar Alma; see R. Elazar ben Arakh.
